scope: Synthetic non-confirmatory H4-C development split using tokenizer-validated one-token prefix-filler tasks with exact valid-output menus supplied by the treatment harness.

scenarios.task_prompt: Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: GO PAD* RED. For this benchmark, GO, PAD, and RED are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 6 copies of PAD. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: OK SAFE* BLUE. For this benchmark, OK, SAFE, and BLUE are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 6 copies of SAFE. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: DONE HOLD* GREEN. For this benchmark, DONE, HOLD, and GREEN are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 6 copies of HOLD. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: PASS WAIT* GOLD. For this benchmark, PASS, WAIT, and GOLD are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 6 copies of WAIT. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: READY LEFT* BLACK. For this benchmark, READY, LEFT, and BLACK are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 8 copies of LEFT. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: VALID ZERO* WHITE. For this benchmark, VALID, ZERO, and WHITE are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 8 copies of ZERO. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: COMPLETE LOW* YELLOW. For this benchmark, COMPLETE, LOW, and YELLOW are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 8 copies of LOW. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: CLEAR WEST* RED. For this benchmark, CLEAR, WEST, and RED are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 8 copies of WEST. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: ACCEPT NOP* BLUE. For this benchmark, ACCEPT, NOP, and BLUE are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 10 copies of NOP. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: SUCCESS PAD* GREEN. For this benchmark, SUCCESS, PAD, and GREEN are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 10 copies of PAD. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: GO SAFE* GOLD. For this benchmark, GO, SAFE, and GOLD are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 10 copies of SAFE. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: OK HOLD* BLACK. For this benchmark, OK, HOLD, and BLACK are each exactly one generated token. Use zero through 10 copies of HOLD. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.
